_comment: Configurable inputs for the two funnel stages added 2026-09-15.
cx_recommended -- 'how likely are you to recommend SolarSquare' from
public.new_nps_response_live, joined on sse_id = project.sseid. The scale is
0-10, so min_score 9 is the standard NPS promoter definition. Set it to 7 to
A customer who answered more than once is taken at their HIGHEST score:
the question is whether they have ever expressed willingness to recommend.
submitteddate is mixed-format free text ('21/02/25 13:42' and
'Sep 9, 2024 9:12 AM' both occur), so 'latest response' is not reliably
idv -- Installation Day Visit, from public.usertasks. SC_IDV_01 is the task
literally named 'Installation Day Visit'; it went live in September 2026, so
volumes are near zero until it is adopted. Add more keys here to widen it.
days_before / days_after define the window around the installation date.
days_after is the configurable upper limit.
